NETWORK  egress — private netns (one per sandbox) with a pasta helper.
         host loopback   UNREACHABLE (--map-host-loopback none, -T none, -U none)
         abstract unix   UNREACHABLE (netns-scoped)
         pathname sockets (X11, D-Bus, Wayland, ssh-agent) — see FILESYSTEM,
                         not this block; a directory grant can expose one
         egress          full, IPv4 + IPv6
         dns             NONE — no resolver is named inside; lookups fail fast
                         (this profile grants egress but never asked for DNS)
         host -> sandbox CLOSED — nothing is forwarded into this
                         namespace. A door a human can open is declared with
                         listen_names in a profile; see below.
         address         copied from the host — add '@net-anon' to hide it
         host's own IPs  unreachable, incidentally rather than by design: they are
                         on the sandbox's own interface, so a connection to one
                         never leaves the netns. '@net-anon' removes that.
